an5.50:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā nārado pāṭalīputte viharati kukkuṭārāme.
an5.50:1.2: tena kho pana samayena muṇḍassa rañño bhaddā devī kālakatā hoti piyā manāpā
an5.50:1.3: so bhaddāya deviyā kālakatāya piyāya manāpāya neva nahāyati, na vilimpati, na bhattaṃ bhuñjati, na kammantaṃ payojeti.
an5.50:1.5: atha kho muṇḍo rājā piyakaṃ kosārakkha āmantesi:
an5.50:1.6: tena hi samma piyaka bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjetha yathā mayaṃ bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ cirataraṃ passeyyāmāti.
an5.50:1.7: evaṃ devāti kho piyako kosārakkho muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujji.
an5.50:2.2: “imassa kho muṇḍassa rañño bhaddā devī kālakatā piyā manāpā.
an5.50:2.3: so bhaddāya deviyā kālakatāya piyāya manāpāya neva nahāyāti, na vilimpati, na bhattaṃ bhuñjati, na kammantaṃ payojeti.
an5.50:2.5: kaṃ nu kho muṇḍo rājā samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā payirupāseyya yassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyā”ti.
an5.50:3.2: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā nārado pāṭalīputte viharati kukkuṭārāme.
an5.50:3.3: taṃ kho pana āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
an5.50:3.4: paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho ceva arahā ca.
an5.50:3.5: yaṃ nūna muṇḍo rājā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ payirupāseyya, appevanāma muṇḍo rājā āyasmato nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyā”ti.
an5.50:4.1: atha kho piyako kosārakkho yena muṇḍo rājā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etadavoca:
an5.50:4.2: “ayaṃ kho deva āyasmā nārado pāṭalīputte viharati kukkuṭārāme.
an5.50:4.3: taṃ kho panāyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
an5.50:4.4: paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho ceva arahā ca.
an5.50:4.5: yadi pana devo āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ payirupāseyya, appevanāma devo āyasmato nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyā”ti.
an5.50:4.6: tena hi samma piyaka āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ paṭivedehi.
an5.50:4.7: kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
an5.50:4.8: evaṃ devā’ti kho piyako kosārakkho muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā yenāyasmā nārado tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho piyako kosārakkho āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ etadavoca:
an5.50:5.1: imassa bhante muṇḍassa rañño bhaddā devī kālakatā piyā manāpā.
an5.50:5.2: so bhaddāya deviyā kālakatāya piyāya manāpāya neva nahāyati, na vilimpati, na bhattaṃ bhuñjati, na kammantaṃ payojeti.
an5.50:5.4: sādhu bhante āyasmā nārado muṇḍassa rañño tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathā muṇḍo rājā āyasmato nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyā’ti
an5.50:6.1: atha kho piyako kosārakkho uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena muṇḍo rājā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etadavoca:
an5.50:6.4: ‘tena hi samma piyaka bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpehī’ti
an5.50:6.5: evaṃ devā’ti kho piyako kosārakkho muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etadavoca:
an5.50:6.6: yuttāni kho te deva bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni.
an5.50:7.1: atha kho muṇḍo rājā bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhirūhitvā bhadrehi yānehi yena kukkuṭārāmo tena pāyāsi mahaccā rājānubhāvena āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ dassanāya
an5.50:7.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi tāvatikaṃ yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikova ārāmaṃ pāvisi.
an5.50:7.3: atha kho muṇḍo rājā yenāyasmā nārado tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmanaṃ nāradaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ āyasmā nārado etadavoca:
an5.50:8.1: pañcimāni mahārāja alabbhanīyāni ṭhānāni samaṇena vā brāhmaṇenavā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
an5.50:8.3: jarādhammaṃ mā jīrīti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇenavā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
an5.50:8.4: vyādhidhammaṃ mā vyādhīyīti …pe… maraṇadhammaṃ mā mīyītī, …pe… khaya dhammaṃ mā khīyīti …pe… nassanadhammaṃ mā nassīti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.
an5.50:9.1: assutavato kho mahārāja puthujjanassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati.
an5.50:9.2: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe na iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.50:9.3: na kho mayhamevekassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati. atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ jīrati.
an5.50:9.4: ahaṃ ceva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ, kilameyyaṃ, parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattampi me nacchādeyya. kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya. kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ. amittā’pi attamanā assu. mittā’pi dummanā assū’ti.
an5.50:9.5: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe socati, kilamati, paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.50:9.7: assutavā puthujjano viddho savisena sokasallena attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.50:10.1: puna caparaṃ mahārāja assutavato puthujjanassa vyādhidhammaṃ vyādhīyati …pe… maraṇadhammaṃ mīyati …pe… khayadhammaṃ khīyati …pe… nassanadhammaṃ nassati.
an5.50:10.2: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe na iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.50:10.3: na kho mayhamevekassa nassanadhammaṃ nassati. atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ nassanadhammaṃ nassati.
an5.50:10.4: ahañceva kho pana nassanadhamme naṭṭhe soceyyaṃ, kilameyyaṃ, parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattampi me nacchādeyya. kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya. kammantā’pi nappavatteyyuṃ.. amittā’pi attamanā assu. mittā’pi dummanā assū’ti.
an5.50:10.5: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe socati, kilamati, paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.50:10.7: assutavā puthujjano viddho savisena sokasallena attānaṃ yeva paritāpetīti.
an5.50:11.1: sutavato ca kho mahārāja ariyasāvakassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati.
an5.50:11.3: na kho mayhamevekassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati. atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ jīrati.
an5.50:11.4: ahañceva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ, kilameyyaṃ, parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattampi me nacchādeyya. kāye’pi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya. kammantā’pi nappavatteyyuṃ. amittā’pi attamanā assu. mittā’pi dummanā assū’ti
an5.50:11.5: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe na socati, na kilamati, na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.50:11.7: sutavā ariyasāvako abbahi savisaṃ sokasallaṃ yena viddho assutavā puthujjano attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.50:11.8: asoko visallo ariyasāvako attānaṃ yeva parinibbāpeti.
an5.50:12.1: puna caparaṃ mahārāja sutavato ariyasāvakassa vyādhidhammaṃ vyādhīyati. …pe… maraṇadhammaṃ mīyati …pe… khayadhammaṃ khīyati …pe… nassanadhammaṃ nassati.
an5.50:12.3: na kho mayhamevekassa nassanadhammaṃ nassati. atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ nassanadhammaṃ nassati.
an5.50:12.4: ahañceva kho pana nassanadhamme naṭṭhe soceyyaṃ, kilameyyaṃ, parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattampi me nacchādeyya. kāye’pi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya. kammantā’pi nappavatteyyuṃ. amittā’pi attamanā assu. mittā’pi dummanā assū’ti.
an5.50:12.5: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe na socati, na kilamati na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.50:12.7: sutavā ariyasāvako abbahi savisaṃ sokasallaṃ yena viddho assutavā puthujjano attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.50:12.8: asoko visallo ariyasāvako attānaṃ yeva parinibbāpeti.
an5.50:13.1: imāni kho mahārāja pañca alabbhanīyāni ṭhānāni samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti,
an5.50:18.1: evaṃ vutte muṇḍo rājā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ etadavoca:
an5.50:18.5: taggha bhante sokasallaharaṇo. imaṃ hi me bhante dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pahīṇanti.
an5.50:19.1: atha kho muṇḍo rājā piyakaṃ kosārakkhaṃ āmantesi:
an5.50:19.2: “tena hi samma piyaka, bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ jhāpetha. thūpaṃ cassā karotha.
an5.50:19.3: ajjatagge’ dāni mayaṃ nahāyissāma ceva vilimpissāma. bhattaṃ ca bhuñjissāma. kammante ca payojessāmā”ti.
